tasks.title: Create Configuration Validation Module
tasks.description: Implement a configuration validation module that checks for required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) on application startup. Should throw descriptive errors if variables are missing or invalid format.
acceptance_criteria: Throws clear error messages for missing/invalid config
tasks.technical_notes: Use regex for UUID validation, consider using a config schema validator like joi or zod

tasks.title: Implement Input Validation for Task Operations
tasks.description: Create validation functions for task creation and update operations. Validate required fields, data types, string lengths, and enum values (status types).
acceptance_criteria: Validates task title (required, non-empty, max 2000 chars)
Validates status values against allowed list
tasks.technical_notes: Define ALLOWED_STATUSES constant array, consider extracting validation logic before API calls

tasks.title: Enhance Error Handling with Retry Logic
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling with exponential backoff retry logic for transient failures. Handle rate limiting, network errors, and API errors appropriately.
acceptance_criteria: Handles Notion API rate limiting (429 errors)
Differentiates between retryable and non-retryable errors
tasks.technical_notes: Consider using async-retry library or implement custom retry wrapper

tasks.title: Refactor createTask with Enhanced Validation
tasks.description: Update the existing createTask function to use the new validation and error handling modules. Integrate input validation and improved error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Uses input validation before API call
Uses retry handler for API calls
Returns structured response with success/error status
tasks.technical_notes: Ensure function signature remains compatible with existing usage

tasks.title: Refactor updateTask with Enhanced Validation
tasks.description: Update the existing updateTask function to use the new validation and error handling modules. Add support for partial updates and field-level validation.
acceptance_criteria: Uses input validation before API call
Uses retry handler for API calls
tasks.technical_notes: Consider allowing null/undefined for fields that shouldn't be updated

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
tasks.description: Create functions to query and retrieve tasks from the Notion database. Support retrieval by task ID (page ID) and retrieval of all tasks with pagination.
acceptance_criteria: getAllTasks(options) function retrieves all tasks with pagination
Handles pagination automatically or returns page tokens
Transforms Notion API response to simplified format
tasks.technical_notes: Use notion.databases.query() for listing, notion.pages.retrieve() for single item

tasks.title: Implement Task Search and Filtering
tasks.description: Create functions to search and filter tasks based on various criteria (status, assignee, date ranges, text search in title/notes).
acceptance_criteria: searchTasks(filters) function with multiple filter options
Text search in task title and notes
tasks.technical_notes: Use Notion database query filters API, build filter objects dynamically

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion/Archive Functionality
tasks.description: Create function to delete or archive tasks. Notion API archives pages rather than deleting them permanently.
tasks.technical_notes: Use notion.pages.update() with archived: true property

tasks.title: Implement Batch Task Creation
tasks.description: Create function to create multiple tasks in a single operation with proper error handling for partial failures.
acceptance_criteria: createTasksBatch(tasks[]) function accepts array of task objects
Processes tasks concurrently with rate limiting
Returns array of results with success/failure for each
Continues processing if individual tasks fail
tasks.technical_notes: Use Promise.allSettled() for concurrent execution, implement rate limiter (e.g., p-limit)

tasks.title: Implement Batch Task Updates
tasks.description: Create function to update multiple tasks in a single operation with proper error handling for partial failures.
acceptance_criteria: updateTasksBatch(updates[]) function accepts array of update objects
Each update object contains pageId and fields to update
Processes updates concurrently with rate limiting
Returns array of results with success/failure for each
Continues processing if individual updates fail
tasks.technical_notes: Reuse rate limiting logic from batch creation

tasks.title: Implement Structured Logging System
tasks.description: Replace console.log statements with structured logging system supporting different log levels (debug, info, warn, error) and optional log output to file.
acceptance_criteria: Logger module with debug, info, warn, error methods
Configurable log level via environment variable
Structured log format (timestamp, level, message, context)
Option to log to file and/or console
Includes correlation IDs for tracing operations
tasks.technical_notes: Consider using winston or pino for production-grade logging

tasks.title: Create Database Schema Configuration Module
tasks.description: Create flexible configuration for Notion database schema to avoid hardcoded field names. Allow field mapping to be configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Schema config file (JSON or environment variables)
Field name mappings (title, status, assignee, notes, id)
Fallback to default field names if not configured
tasks.technical_notes: Allows system to work with different Notion database structures

tasks.title: Implement CLI Interface
tasks.description: Create command-line interface for interacting with the task manager. Support all CRUD operations and search functionality through CLI commands.
acceptance_criteria: Support for JSON output format option
tasks.technical_notes: Use commander or yargs for CLI parsing, update package.json with bin entry

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests for Validation Modules
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests for configuration validation, input validation, and validation utilities.
acceptance_criteria: Tests for config validator with valid/invalid inputs
Tests for task validation with edge cases
Tests for all validation error scenarios
Minimum 90% code coverage for validation modules
Uses appropriate testing framework (Jest or Mocha)
tasks.technical_notes: Install Jest or Mocha as dev dependency, add test script to package.json

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests for Core Operations
tasks.description: Create unit tests for createTask, updateTask, and other core operations using mocked Notion API client.
acceptance_criteria: Tests for createTask with mocked API
Tests for updateTask with mocked API
Tests for getTaskById with mocked API
Tests for deleteTask with mocked API
Tests for error scenarios and retry logic
Minimum 85% code coverage for core operations
tasks.technical_notes: Mock @notionhq/client, test both success and failure scenarios

tasks.title: Add Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration tests that interact with a test Notion database to verify end-to-end functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Integration test suite using test database
Tests full CRUD lifecycle (create, read, update, delete)
Can run separately from unit tests
Documentation for setting up test database
tasks.technical_notes: Requires separate NOTION_TEST_DATABASE_ID, use test:integration script

tasks.title: Create API Documentation
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive API documentation for all functions, including JSDoc comments in code and markdown documentation.
acceptance_criteria: JSDoc comments for all exported functions
API.md file with detailed function documentation
Parameter descriptions with types and examples
Can generate HTML docs with JSDoc tool
tasks.technical_notes: Use JSDoc standard format, consider using documentation generator

tasks.title: Create Setup and Usage Guide
tasks.description: Create comprehensive README and setup documentation covering installation, configuration, and usage examples.
tasks.technical_notes: Include screenshots/GIFs if creating CLI interface

tasks.title: Implement Rate Limiting Protection
tasks.description: Add proactive rate limiting to prevent hitting Notion API rate limits. Implement token bucket or sliding window algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiter module with configurable limits
Queues requests when limit is reached
Supports different limits for different operation types
tasks.technical_notes: Notion API typically allows 3 requests per second, implement p-limit or bottleneck

tasks.title: Add Assignee Management Functionality
tasks.description: Implement proper assignee handling with support for Notion user IDs or emails. Query Notion users and properly assign tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Function to retrieve Notion workspace users
Support assigning by user email (with lookup)
Cache user lookups to avoid repeated API calls
tasks.technical_notes: Use notion.users.list() to fetch users, implement caching with TTL
